description: This file contains GUI-related functions and color attribute configurations for a configuration interface, including dialog boxes, scroll windows, and color theme setup, used in a menu configuration tool derived from menuconfig.

methods.name: set_colors
methods.description: Initializes color pairs and assigns color attributes based on terminal capabilities.

methods.name: print_in_middle
methods.description: Prints a string centered vertically in a window with specified attributes.

methods.name: get_line_no
methods.description: Counts the number of lines in a text block separated by newline characters.

methods.name: get_line
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the start of a specific line in a text block.

methods.name: get_line_length
methods.description: Calculates the length of a line up to a newline or null terminator.

methods.name: fill_window
methods.description: Fills a window with text, line by line.

methods.name: btn_dialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog with message and buttons, returns the button pressed.

methods.name: dialog_inputbox
methods.description: Displays an input box dialog, allows text input, returns user response.

methods.name: refresh_all_windows
methods.description: Refreshes all panels and windows in the correct order.

methods.name: show_scroll_win
methods.description: Displays a scrollable window with text content.

methods.name: show_scroll_win_ext
methods.description: Displays a customizable scrollable window with additional features and callbacks.
